title: Neko button
description: A soft-cornered 48/60px pill-rectangle with the label and a thin arrow after it: brand blue for joining, charcoal for everything else. Darkens or lightens on hover in 150ms.
notes: the dark variant is foreground-coloured: charcoal on light themes, near-white on dark ones
name: neko-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description: primary: the brand blue (joining, booking) · dark: charcoal (everything else)

props.name: size
props.description: md: 48px tall on phones, 60px from 1024px · sm: 48px everywhere

props.name: arrow
props.description: show the thin arrow after the label (default true)
